items.question: How quickly do you respond to inquiries?
items.answer: We respond to all inquiries within 24 hours. For urgent inquiries, WhatsApp us at +251-911-XXX-XXX for immediate assistance.

items.question: Can I book a tour on the same day?
items.answer: Same-day bookings are subject to availability. Contact us via WhatsApp or phone for last-minute availability. We do our best to accommodate, but cannot guarantee.

items.question: Do you offer airport pickup?
items.answer: Yes! All tours include complimentary hotel pickup and drop-off in central Addis Ababa (Bole, Piassa, Meskel Square areas). Airport pickup can be arranged for an additional fee.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept USD, EUR, and ETB (Ethiopian Birr). Credit cards (Visa, Mastercard) accepted for online bookings. Cash payments accepted on tour (exact change appreciated).
